title: Pin all kb-recovery snapshot commits to the commitRecoverySnapshot helper
goal: Case study task db49d6c6-bdd5-4600-aaea-15a71042ae20 centralized internal kb-recovery snapshot commits in the commitRecoverySnapshot helper in runner/project.js (the only place allowed to pass --no-verify) and added a scope test pinning --no-verify to that span, but nothing enforces the reverse direction: a future change can add a new inline git commit for recovery purposes without the bypass and all tests still pass, silently reintroducing hook-blocked parking (now a wedged flapping task instead of a daemon crash-loop, still blocking that task). Add an architecture test mirroring the existing hook-bypass scope test that fails if recovery-commit construction appears outside the helper — for example scan runner non-test sources for recovery message literals, kb-recovery branch construction, or raw commit argv outside commitRecoverySnapshot and the sanctioned task-branch commit path — and document the rule in runner/README.md. Acceptance: the new test passes on main and fails when a scratch inline recovery commit is added; the existing bypass-scope test still passes.
